## Packages and helpers

```{r packages}
library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(cowplot); library(lme4); library(knitr)
fmt  <- function(x, d = 1) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
n_   <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
q_   <- function(x, p) as.numeric(quantile(x, p))
miqr <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf("%s (%s–%s)", fmt(median(x), d), fmt(q_(x, .25), d), fmt(q_(x, .75), d))
pval <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
NAVY <- "#1f3864"; BLUE <- "#2e75b6"; ORG <- "#c55a11"
tema <- theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#eeeeee"),
        plot.title = element_text(colour = NAVY, hjust = 0.5, size = 11), axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))
```

## Data

`data/facility_years.csv` has one row per facility-year with at least one live birth in the study years 2018, 2019,
2022, 2023 and 2024. The main analysis uses the 12,476 eligible facility-years (`eligible`: at least 100 live births), of
which the 12,104 with complete covariate data (`included_main_model`) enter the model. Variables: `live_births` and
`cesareans` (SINASC); `beds` (funding source derived from CNES beds: SUS = public, Misto = mixed, Privado = private);
`high_risk` (CNES high-risk pregnancy accreditation, Yes/No); `typology` (IBGE rural–urban typology: Rural, Intermediario,
Urbano); `hdi_state` (state HDI of the year); `pct_black_brown` and `pct_previous_cesarean` (facility-level proportions, %).

```{r data}
BANDS <- c("100 - 499", "500 - 999", "1000 - 1499", "1500 - 1999", ">1999")
eleg <- read_csv("data/facility_years.csv", col_types = cols(cnes = "c", cod_mun = "c")) |>
  filter(eligible) |>
  mutate(included = included_main_model,
         volume_band = as.character(cut(live_births, c(100, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, Inf), right = FALSE, labels = BANDS)))
stopifnot(nrow(eleg) == 12476)
BLAB  <- c("100–499", "500–999", "1000–1499", "1500–1999", "≥2000")
COMB  <- c("SUS No" = "Public (SUS), not accredited", "SUS Yes" = "Public (SUS), accredited",
           "Misto No" = "Mixed, not accredited", "Misto Yes" = "Mixed, accredited", "Privado No" = "Private, not accredited")
TYP   <- c("Rural" = "Rural", "Intermediario" = "Intermediate", "Urbano" = "Urban")
d <- eleg |> filter(included) |>
  mutate(rate = 100 * cesareans / live_births,
         band = factor(volume_band, BANDS, BLAB),
         comb = factor(COMB[paste(beds, high_risk)], COMB),
         typ  = factor(TYP[typology], TYP))
stopifnot(nrow(d) == 12104, !anyNA(d$comb), !anyNA(d$band), !anyNA(d$typ))
```

## Study sample (Results, first paragraph; Supplementary Figure S1)

```{r sample}
excl <- eleg |> filter(!included)
tibble(
  `Eligible facility-years (≥100 live births)` = n_(nrow(eleg)),
  `Excluded, missing covariate data` = n_(nrow(excl)),
  `  of which without registered beds (funding source)` = n_(sum(is.na(excl$beds))),
  `  of which without case-mix data` = n_(sum(!is.na(excl$beds))),
  `Included facility-years` = n_(nrow(d)),
  `Distinct facilities` = n_(n_distinct(d$cnes)),
  `Facilities present in all five years` = n_(sum(table(d$cnes) == 5)),
  `Live births` = n_(sum(d$live_births)),
  `Excluded: birth-weighted cesarean rate, %` = fmt(100 * sum(excl$cesareans) / sum(excl$live_births)),
  `Excluded: facility-years with 100–499 births` = n_(sum(excl$volume_band == "100 - 499"))
) |> pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Item", values_to = "Value") |> kable()
```

## Table 1. Characteristics of the included facility-years

```{r table1}
tot_b <- sum(d$live_births)
cat_n <- function(v) d |> count(g = .data[[v]]) |> mutate(val = sprintf("%s (%s)", n_(n), fmt(100 * n / nrow(d))))
t1 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Characteristic = c("Facility-years, n", "Distinct facilities, n", "Live births, n",
                            "Cesarean rate, unweighted facility mean (SD), %", "Cesarean rate, birth-weighted, %",
                            "Annual live births, median (IQR)"),
         Value = c(n_(nrow(d)), n_(n_distinct(d$cnes)), n_(tot_b),
                   sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt(mean(d$rate)), fmt(sd(d$rate))),
                   fmt(100 * sum(d$cesareans) / tot_b),
                   sprintf("%s (%s–%s)", n_(median(d$live_births)), n_(q_(d$live_births, .25)), n_(q_(d$live_births, .75))))),
  tibble(Characteristic = "Annual live births, n (%) of facility-years / % of births", Value = ""),
  d |> group_by(band) |> summarise(n = n(), b = sum(live_births)) |>
    transmute(Characteristic = paste0("    ", band), Value = sprintf("%s (%s) / %s", n_(n), fmt(100 * n / nrow(d)), fmt(100 * b / tot_b))),
  tibble(Characteristic = "Facility type × high-risk accreditation, n (%)", Value = ""),
  cat_n("comb") |> transmute(Characteristic = paste0("    ", g), Value = val),
  tibble(Characteristic = "Municipal typology, n (%)", Value = ""),
  cat_n("typ") |> transmute(Characteristic = paste0("    ", g), Value = val),
  tibble(Characteristic = "State HDI, median (IQR)", Value = miqr(d$hdi_state, 3)),
  tibble(Characteristic = "Facility-level case mix, median (IQR)", Value = ""),
  tibble(Characteristic = c("    Mothers with a previous cesarean, %", "    Black or brown mothers, %"),
         Value = c(miqr(d$pct_previous_cesarean), miqr(d$pct_black_brown))))
kable(t1)
```

## Table 2. Cesarean rates by facility and regional characteristics

Continuous covariates are shown by quartiles of their distribution across the included facility-years.

```{r table2}
t2row <- function(g, data = d) data |> group_by(g = {{ g }}) |>
  summarise(`Facility-years, n` = n_(n()), `Median (IQR), %` = miqr(rate),
            `Birth-weighted, %` = fmt(100 * sum(cesareans) / sum(live_births)), .groups = "drop")
quart <- function(v, dig) {
  k <- q_(d[[v]], c(.25, .5, .75)); g <- cut(d[[v]], c(-Inf, k, Inf), labels = paste0("Q", 1:4))
  rg <- tapply(d[[v]], g, function(z) sprintf("(%s–%s)", fmt(min(z), dig), fmt(max(z), dig)))
  t2row(gq, data = d |> mutate(gq = factor(paste(g, rg[as.character(g)]))))
}
blk <- function(title, x) bind_rows(tibble(g = title), x |> mutate(g = paste0("    ", g)))
t2 <- bind_rows(blk("Annual live births", t2row(band)),
                blk("Facility type × high-risk accreditation", t2row(comb)),
                blk("Municipal typology", t2row(typ)),
                blk("State HDI (quartiles)", quart("hdi_state", 3)),
                blk("Mothers with a previous cesarean, % (quartiles)", quart("pct_previous_cesarean", 1)),
                blk("Black or brown mothers, % (quartiles)", quart("pct_black_brown", 1))) |>
  rename(Characteristic = g) |> mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, "")))
kable(t2)
```

## Other descriptive results reported in the text

```{r text-desc}
hab <- d |> filter(high_risk == "Yes")
tibble(
  `Facility-years with <500 births, %` = fmt(100 * mean(d$live_births < 500)),
  `Accredited facility-years, n` = n_(nrow(hab)),
  `Accredited: public (SUS), %` = fmt(100 * mean(hab$beds == "SUS")),
  `Accredited: mixed, %` = fmt(100 * mean(hab$beds == "Misto")),
  `Accredited: private, n` = n_(sum(hab$beds == "Privado")),
  `Accredited with ≥2000 births, %` = fmt(100 * mean(hab$volume_band == ">1999")),
  `Accredited with <500 births, n` = n_(sum(hab$live_births < 500))
) |> pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Item", values_to = "Value") |> kable()
```

## Figure 1. Cesarean rate by year

```{r fig1, fig.width = 8.2, fig.height = 4.9}
por_ano <- d |> group_by(year) |>
  summarise(`Birth-weighted rate` = 100 * sum(cesareans) / sum(live_births),
            `Unweighted mean of facility-level rates` = mean(rate), .groups = "drop")
kable(por_ano |> mutate(across(-year, ~ fmt(.x))))
pa <- por_ano |> pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "taxa", values_to = "valor") |>
  mutate(taxa = factor(taxa, c("Unweighted mean of facility-level rates", "Birth-weighted rate")),
         seg = ifelse(year <= 2019, "a", "b"), vj = ifelse(taxa == "Birth-weighted rate", 2.0, -1.2))
ggplot(pa, aes(year, valor, colour = taxa)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(taxa, seg)), alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", valor), vjust = vj), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(ORG, NAVY), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(pa$year), limits = c(2017.6, 2024.4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(50, 72), breaks = seq(50, 70, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Cesarean rate (%)", title = "Cesarean rate by year, Brazilian facilities with ≥100 annual births") +
  tema + theme(legend.position = c(0.02, 0.98), legend.justification = c(0, 1), legend.background = element_blank())
```

## Figure 2. Facility-level cesarean rates by characteristics

Boxes show the median and interquartile range; whiskers extend to the most extreme values within 1.5×IQR; points beyond the whiskers are outlying facility-years.

```{r fig2, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 8.4}
caixa <- function(g, titulo, xlab = NULL)
  ggplot(d, aes({{ g }}, rate)) +
    stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3, colour = "grey50", coef = 1.5) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = BLUE, colour = BLUE, width = 0.6, outlier.size = 1.1, outlier.alpha = 0.6, outlier.colour = BLUE, coef = 1.5, median.colour = "white", median.linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) + labs(x = xlab, y = "Cesarean rate (%)", title = titulo) + tema
lab_comb <- setNames(sub(", ", ",\n", COMB), COMB)
plot_grid(plot_grid(caixa(band, "(a) Annual live births", "Annual live births"),
                    caixa(typ, "(b) Municipal typology", "Municipal typology"), ncol = 2, align = "h", axis = "bt"),
          caixa(comb, "(c) Facility type × high-risk accreditation") + scale_x_discrete(labels = lab_comb), ncol = 1)
```

## Table 3. Multilevel binomial model (model 2.6)

Facility-level cesarean counts with total live births as the denominator; logit link; random intercepts for municipality
and state and an observation-level (facility-year) random effect for overdispersion. Reference categories: public (SUS)
facilities without high-risk accreditation, ≥2000 annual births and rural municipality. HDI on its natural scale
(odds ratio reported per 0.1 unit); facility proportions per one percentage point.

```{r model}
dm <- d |> mutate(comb = relevel(comb, ref = "Public (SUS), not accredited"),
                  band = relevel(factor(band, BLAB), ref = "≥2000"),
                  typ  = relevel(typ, ref = "Rural"), obs = factor(row_number()))
ctrl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
m26 <- glmer(cbind(cesareans, live_births - cesareans) ~ comb + band + typ + hdi_state + pct_black_brown +
               pct_previous_cesarean + (1 | cod_mun) + (1 | uf) + (1 | obs),
             data = dm, family = binomial, control = ctrl)
cat("Observations:", nobs(m26), "| convergence:",
    if (is.null(m26@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)) "OK" else paste(m26@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages, collapse = "; "),
    "| residual dispersion:", round(sum(residuals(m26, type = "pearson")^2) / df.residual(m26), 2), "\n")
co <- summary(m26)$coefficients
or_tab <- function(co, escala = c(hdi_state = 0.1), dig_pp = 3) {
  tibble(term = rownames(co), b = co[, 1], se = co[, 2], p = co[, 4]) |> filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
    mutate(k = ifelse(term %in% names(escala), escala[term], 1),
           dig = ifelse(grepl("^pct_", term), dig_pp, 2),
           OR = exp(b * k), lo = exp((b - 1.96 * se) * k), hi = exp((b + 1.96 * se) * k),
           `OR` = mapply(fmt, OR, dig), `95% CI` = paste0(mapply(fmt, lo, dig), "–", mapply(fmt, hi, dig)),
           `p-value` = pval(p)) |> select(term, `OR`, `95% CI`, `p-value`)
}
t3 <- or_tab(co) |> mutate(term = term |> sub("^comb", "", x = _) |> sub("^band", "Annual live births ", x = _) |>
                              sub("^typ", "Municipal typology: ", x = _) |>
                              recode(hdi_state = "State HDI (per 0.1)",
                                     pct_previous_cesarean = "Mothers with a previous cesarean, % (per 1 percentage point)",
                                     pct_black_brown = "Black or brown mothers, % (per 1 percentage point)"))
kable(t3, col.names = c("Predictor", "OR", "95% CI", "p-value"))
```

## Secondary analysis: annual volume as a continuous exposure (log2)

```{r log2}
m_log2 <- update(m26, . ~ . - band + log2(live_births))
c2 <- summary(m_log2)$coefficients["log2(live_births)", ]
cat(sprintf("OR per doubling of annual volume: %.2f (95%% CI %.2f–%.2f); convergence: %s\n",
            exp(c2[1]), exp(c2[1] - 1.96 * c2[2]), exp(c2[1] + 1.96 * c2[2]),
            if (is.null(m_log2@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)) "OK" else "warning"))
```

## Figure 3. Adjusted odds ratios

```{r fig3, fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 6.8}
GR <- c("Facility type × accreditation\n(ref. public, not accredited)", "Annual live births\n(ref. ≥2000)",
        "Municipal typology\n(ref. rural)", "Context and case mix")
f3 <- tibble(term = rownames(co), b = co[, 1], se = co[, 2]) |> filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  mutate(k = ifelse(term == "hdi_state", 0.1, 1), OR = exp(b * k), lo = exp((b - 1.96 * se) * k), hi = exp((b + 1.96 * se) * k),
         grupo = case_when(grepl("^comb", term) ~ GR[1], grepl("^band", term) ~ GR[2], grepl("^typ", term) ~ GR[3], TRUE ~ GR[4]),
         rotulo = term |> sub("^comb|^band|^typ", "", x = _) |>
           recode(Intermediario = "Intermediate", Urbano = "Urban", hdi_state = "State HDI (per 0.1)",
                  pct_previous_cesarean = "Previous cesarean, % (per 1 pp)",
                  pct_black_brown = "Black or brown mothers, % (per 1 pp)")) |>
  bind_rows(tibble(term = "REF", OR = 1, grupo = GR[1], rotulo = "Public (SUS), not accredited (ref.)"))
ord <- c("Public (SUS), not accredited (ref.)", COMB[-1], BLAB[-5], "Intermediate", "Urban", "State HDI (per 0.1)",
         "Previous cesarean, % (per 1 pp)", "Black or brown mothers, % (per 1 pp)")
f3 <- f3 |> mutate(grupo = factor(grupo, GR), rotulo = factor(rotulo, rev(ord)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(f3$rotulo))
ggplot(f3, aes(OR, rotulo)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), width = 0, orientation = "y", colour = NAVY, linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = filter(f3, term != "REF"), colour = NAVY, size = 2.6) +
  geom_point(data = filter(f3, term == "REF"), shape = 23, fill = "white", colour = NAVY, size = 2.8, stroke = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(grupo ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2, 3, 4), limits = c(0.8, 4.5)) +
  labs(x = "Adjusted odds ratio (log scale, 95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  tema + theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank(),
               strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, face = "bold", colour = NAVY, size = 9),
               panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "#eeeeee"),
               panel.spacing.y = unit(4, "mm"))
```
